verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe both halves of the story. Behavioral tests verify expected interactions inside pytest or Vitest suites, and agent simulations run end-to-end conversations against an LLM-driven user and then evaluate the whole interaction. The GitHub README separately advertises a built-in test framework with judges. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the test and simulation tooling, and evidence of simulating telephony-specific conditions before real phone calls.
